notes.title: Small Update - bugfixes
notes.notes:
Fixed all outstanding issues found.

[b]Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Player Stash Fix[/b]: Your player stash is now accessible again after we resolved a bug that was causing it to be inaccessible.
[*] [b]Streamlined Coin Value Display[/b]: Say goodbye to unnecessary decimal points (.00) in the coin value UI for a cleaner look.
[*] [b]Bridge Navigation Mesh Fix[/b]: We've also fixed the bridge navigation mesh, allowing players to reach the academy courtyard without any issues.
[*] [b]Wilds & Ghost Village Navigation Update[/b]: Navigation in the wilds and ghost village has been improved for a smoother gaming experience.
[*] [b]Area Load Error Fix[/b]: We've fixed problems related to area loading to ensure a more stable and enjoyable adventure.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update: Welcome Message & Stash Expansion
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a welcoming message for players 
[*] Fixed dialogue choice color issues
[*] Conducted a spellcheck on dialogues
[*] Updated prices for abilities
[*] Introduced a player stash instance within the academy interior
[*] Expanded player stash capacity to accommodate 8 slots
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Added 2H sword for player and enemies.
[/list]

[b]Updates[/b]

[list]
[*] Added swamp undead enemies and their respective patrol paths.
[*] Added cave entrance to use as doorway to other areas (later).
[*] Updated ghost village enemies and patrols.
[*] Updated Nature scene enemies and patrol paths.
[*] Increased enemy waypoint tolerance (was causing some bugs with patrol).
[*] Goblin warriors now have a small chance to drop an iron dagger.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Removed blocking UI from Starhaven map.
[*] Fixed plus/minus buttons double allocating traits.
[*] Fixed crafting UI starting up as visible on maps without crafting table.
[/list]
